_comment: Performance baseline for bench/compare.mjs. Still empty after P2 on purpose: the engine metrics are now real, but the first numbers recorded on a CI runner become the baseline (a developer-machine number would make every CI run look like a regression). The bench job already runs with --enforce, so the absolute N1 budgets are gating today. Do not hand-edit; it is regenerated on merge to main when a metric improves by more than 10% (18_TESTING.md §9.2).
